research_goal_paragraph: Archetype-C synthetic test tenant (static weights-only geometric analysis), the §9 #30-33 genericity-pass forcing function. Deliberately maximally different from the integer doubler: no runtime input, the model's weight matrix is the subject, each work unit pins a PRNG seed and the executor estimates a floating-point geometric separation statistic (mean absolute cosine similarity over random row pairs) by seeded Monte-Carlo. Consensus rides the #33 determinism contract (seed + canonical quantization) so honest replicas bit-match under exact-hash quorum with no coordinator change. Exists to prove the platform's tenant-neutral contracts host archetype C in Phase 1; see Documentation/AuspexAI/v0.1.0/{genericity_pass_ratification,archetype_c_tenant_design}.md.
prompt_set_characteristics: No prompts. Each work unit carries {seed, n_samples, probe}; the model's weight matrix W is loaded from the worker's local --models dir (BYOM; local_weights_required declares the need).
